feed_title: Rattan Dog Day Bed with Sun Canopy, Woven Outdoor Garden Day Bed, Cushion Included, Beige, One Size | PawLunova Henley
descriptionHtml:
A woven shell. A slanted canopy. A cushion already in it.

Henley is a woven rattan outdoor dog day bed with a slanted canopy and a cushion included, in one size, in beige, for dry supervised afternoons outside.

Two things pull against each other in a garden. The bed that looks right next to your table is a flat cushion on the paving by August. The one that stands up to a season looks like camping kit, so it lives round the side of the house where nobody sees it.

The woven finish is the answer to that. It sits with your own outdoor seating rather than against it, which is why it stays out on the patio and why they actually lie on it.

What they get

  • A woven shell that reads as furniture: The finish sits beside your own outdoor seating instead of fighting with it.
  • A cushion in the box: Their resting surface comes with the bed. Follow its separate care label and store it under cover.
  • Open woven sides: Air moves through rather than standing still around them.
  • A slanted canopy: Shade for lounging in suitable conditions. Move it as the shade moves through the afternoon.

Best for: Supervised lounging on a patio or in a conservatory.

Why it is worth the money

£119 is furniture money, and furniture is what you are buying: a beige woven shell with a canopy over it and their cushion already inside, made to stay where you can see it.

It earns that by being used. A bed that gets hidden away is worth nothing at all, whatever it cost.

The honest part: this is a day bed and not housing. The canopy is shade rather than a roof over a wet night, and it is not all-weather shelter. Soft furnishings come under cover when you go in.

Size and fit

Please contact us for the exact dimensions before ordering. Check the internal resting area, entrance height and supported load. Your dog should be able to enter, stand, turn and lie comfortably.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the frame with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for the cushion, and store soft furnishings under cover. Let every part dry before use.

Outdoor use: Supervise your dog, provide drinking water and safe shade, and move them indoors in extreme weather. A raised bed, canopy or kennel does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Choose with confidence

This outdoor product has a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost. It is not covered by the 100-night sleep trial. Your statutory rights are unaffected. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Can it live outside all year? No. It is built for dry supervised afternoons, so bring the cushion in and keep the shell under cover out of season.

How is this different from Torver? Torver is the woven day bed built around a raised platform, at £109. Take that one to get their cushion up off the paving.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Put a woven day bed with its own canopy where you already sit.
